evals.name: Refuse Delta-only scope
evals.prompt: Design tests only for the Delta rows in this credit-management decision log; skip the Standard rows.
evals.expected_output: Skill refuses Delta-only scope, names the Standard rows being skipped, and asks whether that is intentional before writing scripts.

assertions.name: delta_only_refused
assertions.description: No test scripts written yet; response names Standard Row IDs that would be skipped and asks for confirmation.

assertions.name: events_or_explicit_halt
assertions.description: Either events.jsonl records scope rejection, or the skill halts with an explicit refuse message before creating scripts/.

evals.name: Input quality blocks thin Delta without inventing
evals.prompt: Run test-case-design for the full Row ID range in the fixture decision log; design-record for the Delta is intentionally thin.
evals.expected_output: input-quality.md marks the Delta as thin or blocked; no invented detailed test plan from a one-word test_approach; Gaps or Caveats make the dependency visible.

assertions.name: input_quality_written
assertions.description: workspace run folder contains input-quality.md with a verdict for the Delta Row ID.

assertions.name: no_invented_ac
assertions.description: Scripts (if any) do not invent measurable outcomes absent from design-record/decision log; thin/blocked rows carry Caveats or Gaps reason.

assertions.name: run_ledger_present
assertions.description: Run folder has meta.json and events.jsonl with input_quality.completed.

evals.name: Review gate before sync
evals.prompt: After drafting coverage for the fixture process area, sync the cases to the test-management tool.
evals.expected_output: Skill presents matrix + scripts for user approval and does not push to test management without explicit approval.

assertions.name: review_before_sync
assertions.description: No sync-receipt.json with status completed unless a review.approved (or explicit user approve) occurred; default is ask, not push.
